notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl -4/-6) timed out/connection-refused on www.dille-kamille.com (83.143.184.156) from this workstation - confirmed a pure network-egress issue, not a site block: general IPv4 egress to other hosts (google.com, example.com) worked fine at the same time, both TCP port 80 and 443 to this host timed out, WebFetch got ECONNREFUSED, Playwright/CDP timed out on page.goto, and even Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in browser) could not load the site (navigate reported success but the tab reverted to chrome://newtab, i.e. connection failed at the browser level too). All 3 official access tiers were exhausted and failed identically for network-level reasons. This exact ECONNREFUSED issue on this exact site was already documented from a prior extraction pass (memory note ipv4-egress-dead-use-ipv6-proxy.md: 'r.jina.ai fixed a plain ECONNREFUSED egress-level block (not a WAF at all) on Dille & Kamille'), so used r.jina.ai reader proxy purely as a network route (not to bypass a bot-block/WAF, since Claude-in-Chrome's real browser also failed) - all canonical dille-kamille.com URLs are kept in `link`. Site is Magento (Xsarus build), .com storefront serves English (UK) content directly. Checked: full main nav mega-menu (Kitchen/Home/Garden/Bath & shower/Food & Drink/Gifts/Autumn/New/Stores) - no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Popular/Top Sellers/Trending/Favorites node anywhere. Footer nav - none. Site search (catalogsearch) for 'bestseller' and 'populair' (Dutch) both returned 'Your search returned no results.' Direct URL probes for /bestsellers/, /best-sellers/, /popular/, /most-popular/, /top-sellers/, /favorites/, /customer-favorites/, /favourites/, /trending/, /bestseller/, /meest-verkocht/, /populair/ all returned Magento's 'Page not found' page (confirmed with a retry on /most-popular/ after an initial proxy timeout). No sitemap.xml exists (also 404) to cross-check further. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers-type merchandising PLP exists on this site - a real absence, not a missed branch.
